crm_notes:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary customers are PMs and CS teams.
- Came to us after performance/cost concerns with current vendor (OpenAI + custom router).
- Wants: prompt parity with current prompts, minimal regression risk on summarization and KB answers, predictable latency under 300ms p50 for short chat flows, cheaper per-token for high embedding volume.
- Migration ask: start on Redwood Hosted API for quick integration -> move to Dedicated pool for predictable throughput and VPC isolation. Need compatibility layer to map existing provider's SDK/response shapes.
- Technical: 2M monthly tokens today (peaks to 10M). Target 35% cost reduction without quality loss. Working set: KB embeddings (1.2M docs), chat sessions with KV cache reuse.
- Observed: initial hosted demo showed good latency but 7-10% drop in summarization F1 vs current model (reported by data science). They flagged prompt/tokenization differences.
- Quote from Head of ML: "Prompt parity is non-negotiable — our CX ops rely on consistency."
- Security: strict SSO + audit log retention 1 year, KMS for keys, data residency in us-east required.
- Ops ask: fallback routing to a smaller model during Dedicated maintenance windows, canary traffic split 5/95.
- Purchasing: procurement wants committed spend with reserved capacity pricing for FY27; legal asked for SOC2 + incident SLA addendum.
- Attachments: pricing deck + security FAQ sent (drive links). Several Fireflies recordings of demos.
- Next: SE to run quantized model test on Dedicated mirror, run prompt-parity evaluation suite (30 canonical prompts), produce QA regression report. Follow up meeting scheduled for 2026-03-22 (POC results).
